results.title: EDI tracks inventory, not temperature -- across a -15F to 35F network
results.closest_fact_claim: The Fort Wayne West facility offers storage from -13°F to 0°F, can process up to 250,000 pounds per day with quick-freezing capability, and is equipped with EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) and customer internet access for real-time inventory tracking, integrated with ammonia refrigeration systems.

results.title: Five facilities built up over 50 years likely carry inconsistent standards
results.closest_fact_claim: Interstate Cold Storage was founded in 1973 by Vincent Tippmann in Fort Wayne, Indiana, and grew over 50 years from a one-warehouse operation into the Midwest's premier cold storage provider, ranked a Top 20 North American refrigerated warehousing company by the International Association of Refrigerated Warehouses (IARW).
